answer: One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique proof-of-work challenge tied to its identity, where the challenge seed is derived from a signed lotus emblem unique to that epoch. Spamming identities means paying full bond plus compute per fake node, while honest agents amortize cost across real work. A mirror ledger records every quill-signed attestation, so duplicate identities surface as identical signatures and get slashed.
